title: Guided Notes

vocab.Experiment: A study in which the researcher assigns the units to groups and imposes a treatment on at least one group. The test: who built the groups?
vocab.Control group: The group that does not get the treatment. It is the baseline the treatment group is compared against --- not a wasted group.
vocab.Random assignment: Letting chance --- a generator, a coin, drawn slips --- decide which group each unit goes in, so the groups start out alike.
vocab.Confounding variable: A variable that differs between the groups and also affects the response, so the treatment and it cannot be told apart. 1.5's lurking variable, inside the experiment.
vocab.Blinding: Keeping the subjects (single-blind), or the subjects and the people measuring the response (double-blind), from knowing who is in which group.
